description: This PHP class 'IncludeEmployee' defines a filter field for reports in the OrangeHRM system. It adds conditions to a query builder based on whether an employee's termination record is null or not, enabling filtering for current or past employees.

classes.name: IncludeEmployee
classes.description: A report filter class that allows inclusion of employees based on termination status, used within the OrangeHRM reporting system.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a condition to the query builder to include only employees with null or not null termination records based on the operator.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias 'employee' used in query filtering.
